problem_statement: dns_unpack_name() does not correctly guard against writing past the end of its destination buffer when unpacking a DNS name from a record. The destination-space check is evaluated against the buffer's initial free space rather than the space remaining after labels have been appended, so a name whose labels together exceed the buffer size is not rejected and is written past the end of the buffer (a potential buffer overflow). A name that does not fit in the destination buffer, or that contains a label longer than the 63-byte maximum, must be rejected with -EMSGSIZE instead of being (over-)copied into the buffer.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/lib/dns_resolve -s tests/net/lib/dns_resolve/net.dns.resolve -s net.dns.resolve -O twister-out --no-clean -W
